messages:
Asha Nair: quick thought 2 2 2 2 2 2 2 
We should add a tiny "Explain SLO" pill on SLO cards that shows: which rule matched, why notify was suppressed (if applicable), estimated fanout, and a 7d sparkline. would help reduce wakeups.

Ben Wallace: promising. two constraints: 1) don't compute heavy joins on list pages; 2) tenants must be able to opt out of exposure.

Marta Silva: agreed. implementation idea: per-route 1m summary proto with fields: last_violation_bucket, suppression_reason, notify_count_estimate, 7d_histogram. cheap to fetch and lazy-load details.

Asha Nair: UX: compact pill on card, click expands inline panel with bullets: rule, suppression, routing_tier, est_fanout, and copyable decision-graph. avoid modal.

Ben Wallace: backend: maintain notify_count as an incremental counter in the aggregator job. avoid scanning notify-state at read time. cache summary TTL 2m.

Marta Silva: privacy: strip tenant identifiers from cached payloads and add tenant opt-out flag in config. ops will need a secure debug path for internal users.

ops-bot: rollout task created: feature/explain-slo -> canary 5% -> scheduled 1745701135

Asha Nair: action items: Ben spike aggregator & API, Marta add proto + opt-out, I'll mock panel copy. keep canary scoped to internal.

Ben Wallace: starting spike, will post perf numbers here.

Marta Silva: adding proto to schema repo now.

ops-bot: canary started at 1745701145

Asha Nair: nice. keep it minimal for the pilot. ping if blockers.
